The episodes of the twelfth season of the ''[[Bleach (TV series)|Bleach]]'' [[anime]] series, released on DVD as the {{nihongo|'''Arrancar: Decisive Battle of Karakura arc'''|破面・空座決戦篇|Arankaru Karakura Kessen Hen}}.<ref name="Decisive Battle of Karakura">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B002VQ14PG/ |title=BLEACH 破面・空座決戦篇 1 【完全生産限定版】 [DVD] |publisher=Amazon.co.jp |language=ja |access-date=2009-12-03}}</ref> They are directed by [[Noriyuki Abe]], and produced by [[TV Tokyo]], [[Dentsu]], and [[Studio Pierrot]]. The 17-episode season is based on [[Tite Kubo]]'s ''[[Bleach (manga)|Bleach]]'' [[manga]] series.<ref name="staff">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://pierrot.jp/title/bleach/staff.html|title=ぴえろ BLEACH =ブリーチ=|publisher=[[Studio Pierrot]]|language=ja|access-date=July 18, 2009}}</ref> The season follows the fight between an army of Soul Reapers and [[List of Hollows in Bleach#Arrancar|Arrancars]], with [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Soul Reaper characters by squads|Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto]] defending Karakura Town, and [[Sousuke Aizen]] planning to use the town to invade and destroy the Soul Society. The season moves on to auto-conclusive stories beginning with episode 227.

The season aired from March to July 2009 on TV Tokyo.<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes19/|script-title=ja:第214-226|trans-title=Episodes 214-226|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|language=ja|access-date=October 8, 2009|archive-date=October 11, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121011024231/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes19/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes20/|script-title=ja:第227-239|trans-title=Episodes 227-239|publisher=[[TV Tokyo]]|language=ja|access-date=October 8, 2009|archive-date=October 12, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121012000531/http://www.tv-tokyo.co.jp/contents/bleach/episodes/episodes20/|url-status=dead}}</ref> The English adaptation of the ''Bleach'' anime is licensed by [[Viz Media]],<ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/news/2006-03-15/viz-officially-announces-bleach-anime|title=Viz Officially Announces Bleach Anime|date=March 15, 2006|publisher=[[Anime News Network]]|access-date=April 13, 2009}}</ref> and aired on [[Cartoon Network]]'s [[Adult Swim]] from July to November 2011.<ref name="sixthchedule">{{#invoke:cite|web|url=http://www.adultswim.com/schedule/tools/img/on-air-schedule.jpg |title=Revised 6/22/2011 |publisher=[[Adult Swim]] |access-date=June 27, 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101203054356/http://www.adultswim.com/schedule/tools/img/on-air-schedule.jpg |archive-date=December 3, 2010 |url-status=dead }}</ref> A total of four DVD volumes, each containing four episodes, have been released by [[Aniplex]] from January 27 to April 21, 2010.<ref name="Decisive Battle of Karakura"/><ref>{{#invoke:cite|web|url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B003AGXJCW/ |title=BLEACH 破面・空座決戦篇 4 DVD |language=ja |access-date=2011-04-15}}</ref>

The episodes use four pieces of theme music: two opening themes and two closing themes. The first two episodes use "Velonica" by [[Aqua Timez]] as the opening theme. The second opening theme, {{nihongo|"[[Shōjo S]]"|少女S|Shōjo Esu|"Girls"}} by [[Scandal (Japanese band)|Scandal]] is used for the remainder of the season. The first ending theme, {{nihongo|"Sky Chord (Otona ni Naru Kimi e)"|Sky chord 〜大人になる君へ〜|Sukai Kōdo ~Otona ni Naru Kimi e~|lit. "Sky Chord (To the Adult You)"}} by [[Shion Tsuji]] is used for the first two episodes. The second ending theme is {{nihongo|"Kimi o Mamotte, Kimi o Aishite"|君を守って 君を愛して||"I Will Protect You, I Love You"}} by [[Sambomaster]], used for the remainder of the season.<ref name="ep215">{{cite episode|title=空座町を護れ！死神総登場|series=Bleach|credits=TV Tokyo, Dentsu, Studio Pierrot|network=TV Tokyo|airdate=April 14, 2009}}</ref>

| 1               = Bleach season 12
| EpisodeNumber   = 213
| EpisodeNumber2  = 1
| Title           = The Konso Cop Karakuraizer is Born
| TranslitTitle   = Konsō Deka Karakuraizā Tanjō
| NativeTitle     = 魂葬刑事カラクライザー誕生
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Hodaka Kuramoto
| DirectedBy      = Hodaka Kuramoto
| WrittenBy       = Masahiro Ōkubo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2009|3|31}}
| AltDate         = July 17, 2011<ref name="sixthchedule"/>
| ShortSummary    = Going back to the time when [[Ichigo Kurosaki]], [[Uryū Ishida]] and [[Yasutora "Chad" Sado]] left the world of the living for Hueco Mundo with the help of [[Kisuke Urahara]], the focus is now directed to the events that took place in Karakura Town during that time. Urahara feels that Karakura Town needs protection against hollows now that Ichigo left. In one night, he thinks of a fun way to protect the town, that is to force [[List of Bleach characters#Kon|Kon]] into a team of hollow fighting superheroes called "Konso Cop Karakuraizer". Once Kon adjusts to his new hero suit, he meets the rest of the team, which includes Don Kanonji, [[List of Bleach characters#Tatsuki Arisawa|Tatsuki Arisawa]], [[List of Bleach characters#Chizuru Honshō|Chizuru Honshō]], [[List of Bleach characters#Keigo Asano|Keigo Asano]], and [[List of Bleach characters#Ururu Tsumugiya|Ururu Tsumugiya]], along with Zennosuke Kurumadani. After a successful fight with hollows, the team encounters a woman who appears to be an arrancar.
| LineColor       = C3A78B
}}
{{Episode list/sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 12
| EpisodeNumber   = 214
| EpisodeNumber2  = 2
| Title           = Karakuraizer's Last Day
| TranslitTitle   = Karakuraizā Saigo no Hi
| NativeTitle     = カラクライザー最後の日
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Yasuhiro Matsumura
| DirectedBy      = Junya Koshiba
| WrittenBy       = Masahiro Ōkubo
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2009|4|7}}
| AltDate         = July 24, 2011<ref name="sixthchedule"/>
| ShortSummary    = The assembled team from the previous episode is to infiltrate a gate that the arrancar are using to travel between Hueco Mundo and the world of the living. At the "Hollow Fortress", numerous hollows attack the team. Kanonji and Ururu stay behind to fight the hollows on the outside, and the others enter the "Hollow Fortress". Once inside, they meet one of the many arrancars from Hueco Mundo. Chizuru uses her "Hyper Erotic Powers" to distract the arrancar, and Keigo, Tatsuki and Kurumadani take care of the hollows inside. Kon travels to the center of the fortress, where he meets a hollow and kills it with his "Raiser Beam", exploding and destroying the heart of the fortress, and the fortress itself. In the end, Urahara erects a barrier around Karakura Town, and lulls its citizens, including the Konso Cop Karakuraizer, to sleep.
| LineColor       = C3A78B
}}
{{Episode list/sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 12
| EpisodeNumber   = 215
| EpisodeNumber2  = 3
| Title           = Defend Karakura Town! Entire Appearance of the Shinigami
| TranslitTitle   = Karakura-chō o Mamore! Shinigami Sōtōjō
| NativeTitle     = 空座町を護れ！死神総登場
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Hiroki Takagi
| DirectedBy      = Mitsutaka Noshitani
| WrittenBy       = Kento Shimoyama
| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2009|4|14}}
| AltDate         = July 31, 2011<ref name="sixthchedule"/>
| ShortSummary    = [[Sousuke Aizen]], [[Kaname Tōsen]], and [[Gin Ichimaru]] arrive in Karakura town and are met by the remaining captains of the [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Gotei Thirteen|Thirteen Court Guard Squads]] and their lieutenants. Aizen states how he is aware that he is not in the real Karakura Town and says that after slaughtering them, he will make the Ōken in the [[Bleach (manga)#Plot|Soul Society]]. He says that Las Noches is in the hands of [[List of hollows in Bleach#Espada|Espada]] [[List of hollows in Bleach#Ulquiorra Schiffer|Ulquiorra Schiffer]], at which Ulquiorra appears in the throne room behind [[Orihime Inoue]]. Ichigo Kurosaki senses his appearance and he rushes to the fifth tower where Ulquiorra and Orihime are located. It then goes back to the battle where the captains talk amongst themselves, when suddenly first division captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto|Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto]] unleashes his ''[[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#shikai|shikai]]'' to trap Aizen, Tōsen and Gin. Back in Las Noches, Ulquiorra talks to Orihime, asking if she is scared, to which she replies she is not. The Exequias and their leader, [[List of hollows in Bleach#Rudbornn Chelute|Rudbornn Chelute]], temporarily delay Ichigo. Rudbornn and his men attack, but are stopped by Chad, [[Rukia Kuchiki]] and [[Renji Abarai]]. Ichigo continues on his way eventually breaking through the floor into the throne room, ready to battle.
| LineColor       = C3A78B
}}

| Title           = Elite! The Four Shinigami
| TranslitTitle   = Seiei! Yonnin no Shinigami
| NativeTitle     = 精鋭！四人の死神
| NativeTitleLangCode = ja 
| Aux1            = Hideyo Yamamoto

| ShortSummary    = Ichigo arrives in the fifth tower to save Orihime and confronts Ulquiorra. Ulquiorra unsheathes his sword and they begin their battle. Meanwhile, back at the replica of Karakura Town, Espada [[List of hollows in Bleach#Baraggan Louisenbairn|Baraggan Louisenbairn]] takes command since Aizen is trapped inside Yamamoto's fire prison. His first plan of action is to destroy the four pillars protecting Karakura Town, and he sends out four giant hollows to do the job. Soul Reapers [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Ikkaku Madarame|Ikkaku Madarame]], [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Yumichika Ayasegawa|Yumichika Ayasegawa]], [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Izuru Kira|Izuru Kira]] and [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Shūhei Hisagi|Shūhei Hisagi]] each take one pillar, and after defeating the hollows with ease, are respectively matched up against Choe Neng Poww, Charlotte Chuhlhourne, Avirama Redder, and Findor Calius, four of Baraggan's six ''Fracciones''. Each is introduced to the other and the battle for Karakura Town begins.
| LineColor       = C3A78B
}}
{{Episode list/sublist
| 1               = Bleach season 12
| EpisodeNumber   = 217
| EpisodeNumber2  = 5
| Title           = Beautiful Little Devil Charlotte
| TranslitTitle   = Utsukushiki Koakuma Sharurotte

| ShortSummary    = In his fight, Izuru manages to draw blood against his opponent, Avirama, who proceeds to release his ''[[zanpakutō]]'', ''Águila''. Meanwhile, Yumichika and his opponent, Charlotte, continue their fight, but the two spar while declaring the other ugly. However, both decide that the victor shall be the most beautiful. Charlotte uses several attacks, which are able to injure Yumichika. When Yumichika manages to cut off some of the hair of Charlotte, the latter enrages and releases his ''zanpakutō'', Reina de Rosas. Now stronger than Yumichika, the fight escalates until Charlotte traps Yumichika in a prison of black thorns, which completely encases the combatants and their ''reiatsu'', hiding Yumichika's death from everyone. Upon hearing that his ''reiatsu'' is hidden, Yumichika reveals the true form of his ''zanpakutō'', that of a sword with ''[[kidō]]'' abilities. With its power, he drains Charlotte's ''reiatsu'', claiming victory.
| LineColor       = C3A78B
}}

| EpisodeNumber2  = 6
| Title           = Kira, The Battle Within Despair
| TranslitTitle   = Kira, Zetsubō no Naka de no Tatakai

| NativeTitleLangCode = ja

| OriginalAirDate = {{Start date|2009|5|5}}
| AltDate         = August 21, 2011<ref name="seventhchedule"/>
| ShortSummary    = Yumichika reveals that he uses a nickname for his ''zanpakutō'' to avoid revealing its ''kidō'' abilities so that he can fit in with the eleventh division, there being an unspoken rule against using them. The other fights continue elsewhere, and Findor reveals to Hisagi that he can chip off pieces of his mask to increase his power level. Izuru fights Avirama, whose ''resurrección'' turns him into a bird and enables him to attack Izuru with heavy steel feathers. Izuru uses his ''zanpakutō'', Wabisuke, to make Avirama's wings too heavy to fly, and reveals that it represents the belief of the third division that war is full of despair. He then decapitates Avirama, noting afterward that he does not want to be forgiven.
| LineColor       = C3A78B
}}

| ShortSummary    = Hisagi has difficulty fighting Findor, despite technically being on the same level of power. When Findor releases his ''zanpakutō'', Pinza Aguda, and corners Hisagi with blasts of water, Hisagi reluctantly releases his ''zanpakutō'', Kazeshini. With his ''zanpakutō'' released Hisagi overpowers Findor, seeing this Findor breaks off ninety percent of his mask, now making him much stronger, but Hisagi easily damages him leaving Findor paralyzed with fear. After overpowering Findor, Hisagi explains that Findor is inferior to him because Findor does not fear his own power. Findor makes a desperate attempt to defeat Hisagi with a ''cero'' blast, but is killed by Hisagi's ''zanpakutō''. Meanwhile, Poww is able to defeat Ikkaku and destroy the pillar he had been guarding. Yumichika says his name as he sees Ikkaku defeated.
| LineColor       = C3A78B

| ShortSummary    = As a result of the pillar being destroyed, the real Karakura Town starts to return, but seventh division lieutenant [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Tetsuzaemon Iba|Tetsuzaemon Iba]] manages to stop it while his captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Sajin Komamura|Sajin Komamura]] faces Poww. Yumichika desperately tries to go after his friend Ikkaku after realizing he had been defeated, but is knocked unconscious by Hisagi and Izuru for his own good. Poww knocks Komamura aside with a single punch in his unreleased state, and releasing his ''zanpakutō'', Calderón, vastly increases his size and tries to finish off Ikkaku and Iba. Komamura, however, manages to overpower and defeat him easily with his ''bankai''. Iba reprimands Ikkaku for failing to protect the pillar because of his desire to avoid revealing his own strength, and tells him that if he wishes to fight, he must carry out his orders even at the cost of his own life. Baraggan grows visibly angry because of the defeat of his ''Fracciones''.
| LineColor       = C3A78B
}}

| ShortSummary    = Barragan's two remaining ''Fracciones'', Ggio Vega and Nirgge Parduoc, offer to deal with the other Soul Reapers themselves, ending up facing against second division captain [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Suì-Fēng|Suì-Fēng]] and lieutenant [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Marechiyo Ōmaeda|Marechiyo Ōmaeda]]. The respective eighth and thirteenth division captains [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Shunsui Kyōraku|Shunsui Kyōraku]] and [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Jūshirō Ukitake|Jūshirō Ukitake]] face [[List of hollows in Bleach#Coyote Stark & Lilinette Gingerbuck|Coyote Stark]], but are unwilling to fight against his ''Fracción'', [[List of hollows in Bleach#Coyote Stark & Lilinette Gingerbuck|Lilinette Gingerbuck]]. While tenth division captain [[Tōshirō Hitsugaya]] begins fighting [[List of hollows in Bleach#Tier Halibel|Tier Halibel]], lieutenant [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Rangiku Matsumoto|Rangiku Matsumoto]] begins fighting her ''Fracciones'', who are able to defend themselves against the ability of her ''zanpakutō'' by using the ''cero'' blast. While Ōmaeda struggles against Nirgge, Suì-Fēng is able to pin Ggio to the wall and releases her ''zanpakutō''.
| LineColor       = C3A78B
}}

| ShortSummary    = Ayon goes into a rage after being wounded by Yamamoto and increases in size, but Yamamoto easily defeats it and Halibel's three ''Fracciones''. Hitsugaya struggles against Halibel, who reveals that she is the Third Espada and then hits him with a torrent of energy. Kyōraku fights Stark, who reveals that he is the First Espada. Elsewhere in Las Noches, Chad and Renji have defeated the Exequias, as Rukia is left to battle Rudbornn. Ichigo continues his fight with Ulquiorra, and despite Ulquiorra's claim that Ichigo's friends and the Soul Reapers will be defeated, Ichigo has faith in their victory and continues to fight against him.
| LineColor       = C3A78B

| ShortSummary    = In the world of the living, much of the main class is attending their first day at Karakura High School. Ichigo and Chad met and befriend Keigo and [[List of Bleach characters#Mizuiro Kojima|Mizuiro Kojima]] while saving Keigo from some thugs. Orihime meets Chizuru, who tries to woo her only to be kicked in retaliation by Tatsuki. In the Soul Society, the lieutenants meet and decide to promote Renji to the lieutenant of the sixth division and send Rukia to Karakura Town. Renji discusses his promotion with his friends, but decides to make it a surprise for when Rukia gets back. Rukia, after speaking with her captain and third seat officers, heads to Karakura town, at the same time as the first episode begins.

| ShortSummary    = The Soul Reapers decide to take a vacation to the ocean in the world of the living because captain [[Byakuya Kuchiki]] destroyed the pool the Women's Soul Reaper Association covertly built in his mansion. The association shop for swimsuits and then head for the beach where everyone meets up. After attending Ukitake's weak body from the heat, they form groups to produce works of art on the beach for a competition. Watermelon-like monsters attack and most of the Soul Reapers are helpless against them without their ''zanpakutō'' until [[List of Bleach characters#Yoruichi Shihōin|Yoruichi Shihōin]] and Suì-Fēng defeat them. It is then revealed that [[List of Soul Reapers in Bleach#Retsu Unohana|Retsu Unohana]] arranged the event with Byakuya and Ukitake as a game of splitting watermelons, and several more arrived as the episode ends.
| LineColor       = C3A78B

| ShortSummary    = Ikkaku and Yumichika travel to Karakura Town on an assignment to catch a hollow that had attacked a convoy in the Soul Society. The two travel to Ichigo's house planning to stay there until their assignment is complete. Ichigo, however, turns them down and takes them to Keigo's house. Keigo's sister, Mizuho Asano, is all over Ikkaku until Yumichika glues a wig to his head. Mizuho gets upset and makes life difficult for the pair. After a falling out with Mizuho, Ikkaku and Yumichika camp outside instead. While Mizuho with Keigo to buy some juice, she is attacked by the hollow. After some difficulty removing the wig from himself, Ikkaku gets to the scene and saves Mizuho. The next day, Ikkaku and Yumichika prepare to return home. Mizuho knows Ikkaku rescued her and both of them return to good terms.
| LineColor       = C3A78B
